payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about pivot-based methods as a baseline in translation models, including their definition and comparison with other methods.

claims.text: Pivot-based methods are a common strategy to obtain a source to target model by introducing a pivot language.
The pivot-based method is one of the four main categories of existing translation methods.
Pivoting is identified as the strongest baseline with significant advantages over other methods.
The pivot-based method can be further divided into pivoting and pivot-synthetic approaches.
